cohort.name: boxed-numeric-v2
cohort.definition: gold solution contains exactly one literal \boxed marker, well-formed and non-empty; strip outer whitespace then full-match number := -?digits(.digits)?(\%)?; fraction_latex := -?\frac{digits}{digits}; fraction_slash := -?digits/digits; digits := [0-9]+; numbers parsed with decimal.Decimal, percentages divided by 100; all paths canonicalized with fractions.Fraction; parse failures including zero denominators are invalid
